primer: TORPC tier-2. Numbers are ALREADY DECIMAL (NOT hex); events/functions are DECODED with named args (e.g. {event:"Transfer", args:{from,to,value}}); field names are compacted.

questions.prompt: What is the sender (from) address of this transaction?
What is the recipient (to) address of this transaction?
What is the nonce of this transaction, as a decimal integer?
What is the value of this transaction, in wei as a decimal integer?
What ERC-20 function does this transaction call? (function name)
In this ERC-20 transfer call, what recipient address is encoded in the calldata?
In this ERC-20 transfer call, what is the amount as a decimal integer (decoded from calldata)?
